title: Fixed-width r||s ECDSA signatures
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1.

statements.label: Fixed-width r||s ECDSA signatures
statements.requirement: ES256 signatures SHALL be carried as 64-byte r||s. The library SHALL convert from and to the ASN.1 DER form returned or expected by platform crypto APIs (JCA, Android Keystore, PKCS#11, RustCrypto). The verifier SHALL reject an ES256 signature that is not exactly 64 bytes.

sources.quote: For ES256 the COSE signature value is the fixed-width concatenation r || s, 32 bytes each — not the ASN.1 DER encoding
